title: Program Catch-Up Days for Kestrel Auto Finance Cure Payments
content:
A cure payment on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts also carries a catch-up amount, applied to principal, equal to one day's interest on the principal balance at the contract APR over the tier's day-count basis multiplied by the catch-up days and rounded to the cent.

**Program schedule.** The catch-up days are raised by the vehicle program on the purchase order the contract finances, as recorded on the customer's Vehicle Purchase Agreements order:

| Vehicle program | Catch-up days added |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line or Kestrel Inspected | entry-program catch-up days: 4 |
| Kestrel Certified or Kestrel Certified Plus | certified-program catch-up days: 2 |
| any higher program | none |

The days are added whatever the delinquency or tenure of the contract.

## Hypothetical readings

- Starting catch-up days of 10 on a vehicle sold under Kestrel Value Line become 14.
- Starting catch-up days of 5 on a vehicle sold under Kestrel Certified become 7.
- No starting catch-up days, on a vehicle sold under Kestrel Inspected: 4 days.
- On a principal balance of 14200.00 at 19.59 percent over a 365-day basis, 14 days give a catch-up amount of 106.70 and 7 days give 53.35.
